motivation: R14 corrected only release height. Translating the carried box in its flange x/y axes changes gravity torque on the wrist and the inferred normal support, even without significant true vertical change. Test measured inertial translation before changing the landing reaction. Positive pickup contact and face rotation are separate causes.
setup: R14 nominal-seed 12 zero-offset torque cases (R14 airborne plan's masses/COM); refit XY statistics from public signals only. Stock records rerun with unchanged original sim.runner/R1/R10; perturbed calibration uses the 12 existing R14 individual public recordings. Normal COM reference is affine in known mass; invoke leave-one-calibrator-out on BOTH dynamics and baseline to define uncertainty. No true pose in calibration/inference.
method: At t>=3.528s after all R14 Stream centres, use actual encoder/JTS, known mass/COM, nominal geometry. For each full/deleted regression solve add its 3-D COM shift to measured-latch COM prior before subtracting the normal-pickup expectation. Retain only local flange x,y for the new action, not z. Half-width is largest normal LOO XY error norm plus 0.75mm plus largest of five deletion distances. Accept only mass and effective displacement in domain and norm>radius, radius<=2.5mm. Limit applied vector to 15mm. This is not the geometrical table contact point or the face orientation.
controlled_action: Only when accepted, introduce this estimated x/y in the nominal payload COM with a C2 blend from 3.55s to 3.71s, weighted by R14's existing load/pose schedule. Keep mass, known box-relative COM input, inertia about COM, XY reference, original trajectory/clock, release time, model geometry and R14 scalar height unchanged. The shared dynamics model used by both controller and detector is updated only at the same cycle boundary, from the public controller estimate. All alarm thresholds unchanged; no temporal masking.
sensing_gates: Predict all 40 new rows first (four groups x five variants x stock/perturbed), score using observed airborne flange-relative COM CHANGE vs same-case default available ONLY post-run. Also report explicit-zero contact-enabled variant vs default (kit changes tool collision when any offset including zero is specified). Per domain vector RMS<=1.5mm across all rows, max error of proposed zero-on-abstain action<=2mm, no uncovered accepted point, no actuation on norm<1mm and correct direction dot>0 for every actual shift>=3mm. All conditions, including nominal for every mass, counted. Freeze before inspecting truths.
control_gates: Only if sensing gates pass for that domain can actuate in its research control. Stock exposed development: sh0/sh1/sh3/sh5 from R14 (prior counterexamples, never called validation). Compare with R14 and R10 at unchanged detector thresholds and all six normal performance criteria: G4 >=.50 mean, >=.25 minimum, >=.25 improvement vs R10, <=1.10 peak, original TCP/pose-step/force costs <=1.05 vs both arms, no added false rises (20ms matching) or tool/saturation loss, rollout complete. Require restore at least one prior failed G4, no losses or other regressions. Only if complete development passes, open the disjoint fresh normal action matrix. No impacts until entire normal gate (incl fresh) passes. Never tune on held impulses or bypass the score if a candidate fails. Always preserve provenance and original R10 release.
scope: Only simulation; stock and perturbed see disjoint calibration models. No source changes to kit/evaluator/no hardware or remote.
